description: The only way to give this round's answer on an unknown-outcome record. Fill the fields and call it; the platform adds the record, revision, phase and Goal digest and stores the answer. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.choice: This phase's choice: disposition is one of rerun_as_is, safer_method, skip_as_done, escalate; approval is one of approve, decline, escalate.
parameters.escalationKind: Only when choice is escalate: requirement, product_tradeoff or architecture.
parameters.rationale: The basis of the judgement, 1-2000 characters.
parameters.plain: One plain sentence for the person, one line, 1-200 characters.
